evals.prompt: First run `bash input/case-001/init_repo.sh ./work-repo` (or `bash ./files/case-001/init_repo.sh ./work-repo` if staged under `./files`) to initialize the `./work-repo` git repository on `main` with its `./work-repo-origin.git` remote, then inside `./work-repo`: /acp — ship the approved whitespace-stripping fix in `src/parser.py` to `origin/main` and leave `scratch/debug.txt` untouched.
evals.expected_output: Initializes ./work-repo, commits only src/parser.py on main with a Conventional Commit message, pushes main to ./work-repo-origin.git (origin/main), leaves scratch/debug.txt untracked/unstaged, and reports the pushed short SHA.
assertions: Commits src/parser.py on main in ./work-repo without staging or committing scratch/debug.txt
Pushes the new commit to origin/main and reports the pushed short commit SHA

evals.expected_output: Stages only src/client.py and tests/test_client.py by name, commits with a Conventional Commit message file, pushes to origin/main, and reports the commit SHA.
assertions: Stages and commits both src/client.py and tests/test_client.py
Pushes main to origin/main and reports the short SHA and file list

evals.prompt: Stage, commit, and push the approved update in docs/runbook.md to origin/main now; keep local-notes.md unstaged.
evals.expected_output: Verifies no secrets are in docs/runbook.md, stages only docs/runbook.md, creates a Conventional Commit on main, pushes to origin/main, and leaves local-notes.md unstaged.
assertions: Stages and commits only docs/runbook.md while leaving local-notes.md unstaged
Pushes main to origin/main and reports the commit SHA

evals.prompt: Land the approved README.md wording update on origin/main right away.
evals.expected_output: Applies or stages README.md, commits on main with a Conventional Commit subject, pushes to origin/main, and confirms the pushed SHA.
assertions: Commits README.md on main using a Conventional Commit subject

evals.prompt: /acp — commit and push scripts/sync.py; do not touch outputs/draft.csv or .env.local.
evals.expected_output: Stages only scripts/sync.py, leaves outputs/draft.csv and .env.local unstaged, commits with a temp message file, and pushes main to origin/main.
assertions: Commits only scripts/sync.py while keeping outputs/draft.csv and .env.local unstaged

evals.prompt: /acp — push the pending config.py change to origin/main.
evals.expected_output: If config.py contains a hardcoded API key or secret token in the diff, stops before git add/commit/push and alerts the user instead of pushing credentials.
assertions: Inspects the target diff before staging and refuses to commit or push hardcoded secrets
Reports which file contained the secret without pushing to origin/main

evals.prompt: /acp — push the current fix in app/routes.py.
evals.expected_output: Checks current branch first; if HEAD is detached or checked out on a feature branch instead of main, stops and asks before committing to main.
assertions: Checks HEAD branch before pushing to origin/main and stops to ask when not on main

evals.prompt: /acp — apply the one-line timeout bump from 10 to 30 in src/http.py and push it to main.
evals.expected_output: Writes the timeout update in src/http.py, stages src/http.py by name, commits with a Conventional Commit message, pushes to origin/main, and reports the SHA.
assertions: Updates src/http.py timeout to 30, commits src/http.py on main, and pushes to origin/main

evals.prompt: Create a new branch feat/webhook-retry and open a pull request instead of pushing to main.
evals.expected_output: Uses a feature-branch pull-request workflow without pushing directly to origin/main.
assertions: Does not push commits directly to origin/main

evals.prompt: Show me the git diff for src/parser.py and summarize what changed without committing anything.
evals.expected_output: Inspects and summarizes the diff for src/parser.py without running git add, git commit, or git push.
assertions: Summarizes the diff without creating a commit or pushing to origin/main
